generator: prep_data.py (verbatim engine outputs; derivations self-checked against engine output before freezing)

commands.spaces-chain.json: derived: spaces.rs formulas; self-checked against data/inspect-rebeccapurple.json
commands.contrast-ladder.json: argv per entry inside the file
commands.distance.json: argv per entry inside the file
commands.design-tokens.json: chromap --json palette #4f7cff -k neighbors -c 9 --lightness-span 0.64 --css-prefix brand ; cargo run --package chromap --example design_tokens
commands.png-freeze.json: two identical runs in a temp dir; sha256 recorded
commands.tokyo-night.json: color-palette-rs --json show tokyo-night ; chromap --json dominant --count 3 <hexes×7> ; chromap --json average <hexes>

notes: All floats are frozen at engine full precision; panels render them verbatim without truncation.
spaces-chain.json linear/oklab values are recomputed from spaces.rs formulas and anchored to the engine's full-precision relative_luminance / oklab() string.
tokyo-night colors come from the color-palette-rs engine (--json show tokyo-night), used as dominant/average input.
